LightningComponentBundle.description: Loads a slice of a Big Object in chunks and filters it in the browser on fields the Big Object index cannot reach.

property.name: bigObjectApiName
property.label: Big Object API Name
property.description: API name of the Big Object to explore. Must end in __b.

property.name: indexFields
property.label: Index Fields
property.description: Comma-separated list of the fields of the Big Object index, in the order the index declares them.

property.name: indexSortDirection
property.label: Index Sort Direction
property.description: Sort direction of the index fields as declared in the index, e.g. DESC or DESC,ASC,ASC. Fields without a listed direction are ASC.

property.name: displayFields
property.label: Display Fields
property.description: Comma-separated list of the fields shown as columns in the record list, each with its own filter.

property.name: detailFields
property.label: Detail Fields
property.description: Comma-separated list of the fields shown in the detail pane, in order. Leave blank to show every custom field.

property.name: fieldLabels
property.label: Field Labels
property.description: Comma-separated label overrides in the form Api_Name__c=Label.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Title
property.description: Heading of the component. Defaults to the label of the Big Object.

property.name: chunkSize
property.label: Chunk Size
property.description: Number of records loaded per server round trip. Keep it modest for Big Objects with long text fields.

property.name: maxRecords
property.label: Maximum Records
property.description: Maximum number of records loaded into the browser by a single query.

property.name: defaultFilter
property.label: Default Filter
property.description: Initial index filter as semicolon-separated Field=value terms, e.g. Occurred_On__c=LAST_N_DAYS:7. Values can be exact (ACME), a list (A,B), a range (a..b), or TODAY, YESTERDAY, THIS_MONTH or LAST_N_DAYS:n for date fields. Defaults to the last 7 days when the index starts with a date.

property.name: filterableIndexDepth
property.label: Filterable Index Depth
property.description: Number of leading index fields that get a filter input.

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of records per page of the record list.
